title: How to Defeat Kuldra – Final Boss Guide | RuneScape: Dragonwilds

description:
Learn how to defeat Kuldra, the final boss in RuneScape: Dragonwilds. Follow the Anima Pylon and Orb mechanics, use the Anima Cannon, survive her devastating attacks, and destroy Kuldra’s Heart to win the fight.
